title: Chat with AI
description: General-purpose AI assistant for questions, writing, and thinking.
verdict: Start with DeepSeek — genuinely free and rivals ChatGPT for most everyday tasks. Upgrade to ChatGPT Plus or Claude Pro only if you need advanced reasoning, plugins, or heavy daily use.

title: Write Code
description: AI pair programmer for writing, editing, and reviewing code.
verdict: GitHub Copilot has a free tier for individuals but its best features need Pro ($10/mo). For a fully free setup, use DeepSeek's API with any editor. Cursor Pro ($20/mo) is worth it if you code daily and want agentic multi-file edits.

title: Autonomous Coding Agent
description: Delegate entire tickets or refactors to an AI that plans and executes.
verdict: No true free option for full autonomous coding yet. DeepSeek can plan and write code in chat, but real autonomy needs Claude Code or OpenAI Codex ($20/mo).

title: Generate Images
description: Create images, artwork, and graphics from text prompts.
verdict: Nano Banana (free in Gemini) beats most paid tools on editing and accuracy. Midjourney ($10/mo) wins on pure aesthetic quality — worth it for designers and content creators.

title: Generate Video
description: Create AI video clips from text or images.
verdict: Kling and Luma have generous free tiers for short clips. For production work, Veo 3.1 ($20/mo Google AI Pro) has the best quality + native audio. Sora comes bundled with ChatGPT Plus.

title: Voice & Voiceovers
description: Generate realistic AI voices for videos, podcasts, and audio.
verdict: Murf AI has a usable free tier for hobby projects. ElevenLabs Starter at $5/mo is the cheapest quality upgrade in all of AI — worth it the moment you need commercial rights.

title: Music Generation
description: Generate songs, instrumentals, and background music.
verdict: Suno free tier is generous for personal use (no commercial rights). For commercial music, Suno Pro ($10/mo). Udio is better for producers who want granular stem control.

title: Writing & Content
description: Long-form writing, marketing copy, and editing.
verdict: ChatGPT, Claude, and Grammarly free tiers cover 80% of writing tasks. Pay for Jasper/Copy.ai only if you're a marketing team producing content at scale. Surfer SEO is worth it if organic search is your main traffic channel.

title: Research & Papers
description: Search academic papers and get evidence-backed answers.
verdict: NotebookLM is free and unbeatable for analyzing documents you upload. Consensus free tier is fine for casual academic questions. Perplexity Pro ($20/mo) is worth it for researchers doing daily live web research.

title: Presentations & Decks
description: Generate slide decks and pitch presentations quickly.
verdict: Gamma free tier creates impressive decks with Gamma branding. Gamma Plus ($10/mo) removes branding and unlocks premium templates. Beautiful.ai is better for corporate brand consistency.

title: Build a Website
description: Generate full-stack web apps from a description.
verdict: Bolt.new and Lovable free tiers can ship small MVPs. For real projects, Lovable Pro ($25/mo) or Replit Core ($25/mo) — both are cheaper than hiring a developer.

title: Automate Workflows
description: Connect apps and automate repetitive tasks.
verdict: Zapier free tier handles basic automations. Pay for Professional ($20/mo) when you hit task limits. Manus AI is worth it for complex autonomous multi-step workflows.

title: Note-Taking
description: Capture, organize, and query your notes with AI.
verdict: NotebookLM is free and incredible for research notes. Notion AI ($10/mo) is worth it if you're already in Notion. Reflect is best for a personal second brain.
